choose-work.title: How Pivora Chooses Work
choose-work.intro: Three conditions. All three, or Pivora declines.

gates.label: A differentiated platform
gates.test: Enterprise B2B, not a commodity product

gates.label: Executive commitment
gates.test: To the market, not exploratory interest

outcome.pass: All three · we agree the outcome and how it is measured before work starts
outcome.fail: Any one missing · we say so, and usually say who can help

choose-work.caption: You know before the first meeting whether Pivora will take the work, and on what terms.

reference-policy.title: What May Be Published
reference-policy.intro: Three conditions before any client claim appears on this site.

gates.label: Reference calls
gates.test: Offered on request, as a qualification step

outcome.pass: All three met · the outcome is published
outcome.fail: Not yet publishable · the operating cadence, deliverables and governance are shown instead

reference-policy.caption: Nothing on this site cleared a lower bar than this one.

client-commitments.title: What Pivora Needs From You
client-commitments.intro: Seven conditions for a pod to operate as part of your organisation.

gates.label: India time-zone support
gates.test: Key client personnel available during Indian business hours

gates.label: Training content
gates.test: Product documentation, sales kits and training materials

gates.label: Process training
gates.test: Your sales and presales methodology, CRM, approval workflows

gates.label: Sales-operations training
gates.test: Your sales-ops tools and reporting requirements

gates.label: Company email and access
gates.test: Official addresses and application access for pod members

gates.label: Office equipment
gates.test: Laptops and hardware to your standards, where mandated

outcome.pass: All seven in place · the pod operates inside your organisation, not alongside it

client-commitments.caption: A firm that states what it needs from a client is one that has done this before.
